response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced polyglot engineer with a strong background in software quality, full-stack development, and high-throughput microservices. However, this Principal (IC6) role requires deep, specialized domain expertise in enterprise-scale growth, telemetry, and experimentation systems (A/B testing, feature flighting, statistical analysis). While his engineering fundamentals are excellent, his resume lacks the required architectural experience in experimentation platforms and data-driven growth measurement.
strengths: Extensive polyglot engineering experience (JS/TS, C++, Java, DLang) with over 12 years in the industry.
Proven experience designing scalable backend systems, including microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Strong background in software quality, testing frameworks (TDD, CI/CD), and developer tooling.
concerns: Lacks demonstrated experience architecting experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, or A/B testing platforms.
No evidence of the required data aptitude involving statistical methods, telemetry, or growth metrics analysis.
Recent roles lean more toward full-stack product development and open-source mapping rather than enterprise-scale foundational platform architecture.
